question:
Choose the correct one-word substitution for:
"The art of making maps and charts."
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3 i.e. Cartography**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Cartography** refers to the art and science of making maps and charts. (नक्शा बनाने की कला)
 
 
• **Example:** The cartography skills of ancient civilizations were remarkably advanced, as seen in their detailed maps.
 
 
• This word is derived from the Greek words "chartes" (map or paper) and "graphein" (to write or draw). It involves the study, practice, and creation of representations of the Earth's surface.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3 i.e. Cartography**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Calligraphy** (सुंदर लिखावट): The art of beautiful handwriting or decorative writing.
 
 
• **Example:** She learned calligraphy to create stunning wedding invitations.
 
 
 
• **Geography** (भूगोल): The study of Earth's physical features, atmosphere, and human activities.
 
 
• **Example:** Geography helps us understand how natural disasters impact human lives.
 
 
 
• **Topography** (स्थलाकृति): The detailed description or representation of the physical features of a region.
 
 
• **Example:** The topography of the mountain range was carefully mapped by explorers.
